meta.description: 100x10x10mm cantilever beam, fixed at left end, applied torque about z-axis via force couple at free end. Counter-clockwise rotation (ccw) — opposite sense from beam_cantilever_torque_couple_z for sign convention testing.

notes: Torsional loading benchmark (reverse direction): same geometry and magnitude as beam_cantilever_torque_couple_z but with counter-clockwise (ccw) direction. Tests sign convention handling and directional consistency of moment loads. Expected stress magnitude similar, but principal directions should oppose the clockwise case.
